_readme: Per-million-token prices used by scripts/aggregate_run_costs.py to turn
whole-run token counts into money (the cost-per-score axis).
HONESTY RULE: only verified prices go here, with their source. A model
with null prices still gets full token accounting; its cost column stays
empty rather than invented. Local GPU models are priced by the official
hosted list price of the SAME model where one exists (AA convention),
never by a guessed equivalent. Fill nulls from the provider price page
and record the URL + date in `source` before publishing any cost chart.

deepseek-v4-flash.note: judge + several agent runs route through this slug
